'''September 2000 Modesto tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Kriers Cards and Comics, Modesto, CA on 16 September 2000. [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1253">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-19-modesto-ca-9-16d1253/ modesto-ca-9-16], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 19 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-19-modesto-ca-9-16d1253/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Kriers Cards and Comics, Modesto, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 29
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
